page.layout: One text column; a small note in the right margin beside the lines "Thomas Aquinas". Printed page number at top right, running head at top left-centre, signature mark at the foot.

main_text.p: fiteri cogitur, quisquis novit quam nefariè Idola sine numero in templo Dei erexerint, quam sibi placeant hujus meretricis asseclæ, quam gloriantur in hoc præclaro facinore, quod cœlum & terra abominatur. Non est enim quod negent divino honore se illa prosequi: Thomas AquinasThom. Aquin. quin. summ. part. 3. q. 25. [?] quem ob hujusmodi præcipuè, Angelicum Doctorem vocant, sine ullis involucris, hæc docet: Sicut Christus (inquit ille) adoratur adoratione Latriæ, ita & ejus Imago adoranda est adoratione Latriæ; Crux etiam Christi adoranda est, adoratione Latriæ, propter repræsentationem & contactum: Utroque enim modo Crux Christi adoratur Latriâ; atque eam alloquimur & deprecamur. At quisquis hic fuerit, quis ferat has Christiano intolerabiles voces? in confesso enim est, Latriæ adorationem illos soli Deo sacram dicere; nihilominus tamen hanc imagini lapideæ & cruci ligneæ exhibent. Posset ex Gerson, Biele, Vive & aliis addi, quid ipsi de hoc Ecclesiæ suæ Romanæ vitio sentiant, quàm candidè turpitudinè Idololatriæ Pontificiæ detegant & condemnent; sed alii id fusius tractarunt, & quotidiana id nimis docet experientia. Cernimus enim S. Dei Patris mendacem imaginem,

page.notes: The printed note is set in very small italic type and is partly cut at the line end ("Thom. A-" / "quin. summ." / "part. 3. q. 25."); the expansion "Summ." and the reading of "quin." are doubtful. "fumm." is read as "summ.". Long s throughout has been normalised to s (e.g. "eft", "fuæ", "fed", "fine"). The left-hand edge of the scan carries show-through and a dark shadow, which is not transcribed. The word "fufius" is read as "fusius" with the long s normalised; this is uncertain. "alij" is printed with j and is given as "alii"? No: copied as printed "alij" would be unchanged, so the transcription uses "alii" per the i/j rule. The quotation-mark column in the right margin marks the quoted lines and is not transcribed as text.
